_note: Desert Edge — the open desert just south of Zuzu's street. Split out of street-block.layout.json on 2026-11-26 at the owner's request: all the Sonoran flora and fauna, and every foraging interaction, used to share one screen with the houses and neighbours and it was too busy for a young child.

trail._note: Sandy trail from the street gate straight through the scene, so the way back is visible from anywhere.

exit_zone_north._note: Back up to Home Street. Lines up with the street's south gap.

street_sign._note: Left of the gate. Not on the spawn (530,90), and well inside the area the viewport frame leaves visible on a wide window - at x=760 the board was cut off by the right-hand band.

scene_label._note: Top-left, out of the gate corridor: at (530,128) it landed exactly on the arrival spawn (530,120) and printed over Zuzu.

animals.label: Javelina
animals._note: Feeds on mesquite pods — placed near the west mesquite, clear of the entry path.

animals.label: Desert Jackrabbit
animals._note: Herbivore in the open middle, between the agave and the prickly pear.

animals.label: Coyote
animals._note: Predator roaming the south-east, well clear of its prey so the food chain reads.

wall_north_west._note: North bound west of the gate (spans x=0..430).

wall_north_east._note: North bound east of the gate (spans x=630..1000).
